macro_markets.query: What are the most important macroeconomic and stock market news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include major index movements, Fed/central bank news, and significant company earnings or announcements.

items.title: U.S. stocks finish mixed as Fed officials signal patience
items.summary: The Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 0.12% and the S&P 500 gained 0.11%, while the Nasdaq Composite slipped 0.12%. Fed Governor Christopher Waller said disappointing inflation data supports holding rates steady for now, though a later-year cut remains possible.

items.title: Treasury yields remain elevated as markets reassess Fed policy
items.summary: The 10-year Treasury yield recently reached 5.36%, its highest level in 24 years, while the 30-year yield touched 5.73%, the highest since 2002. Investors are weighing persistent inflation against expectations for future Federal Reserve decisions.

items.title: Consumer sentiment weakens while inflation expectations rise
items.summary: The University of Michigan’s preliminary October consumer-sentiment index fell to 46.3, near a multi-decade low. One-year inflation expectations increased to 4.7%, while long-run expectations rose to 3.5%.

items.title: European stocks rise as oil and gold prices fall
items.summary: European equities advanced, with the FTSE 100 up 0.3%, the CAC 40 up 0.4%, and the DAX up 0.5%. Brent crude fell 4.8% to $66 per barrel and West Texas Intermediate declined 5.1% to $61.80.

items.title: Asian markets retreat amid rate and growth concerns
items.summary: The Nikkei 225 fell 1.3%, Hong Kong’s Hang Seng dropped 2.2%, and the Shanghai Composite declined 2.5% in the latest session, reflecting continued caution over global monetary policy and economic growth.

items.title: Home Depot agrees to acquire SRS Distribution
items.summary: Home Depot shares slipped 0.59% after the retailer announced an $18.25 billion acquisition of building-materials supplier SRS Distribution, its largest acquisition to date.

items.title: Delta cuts outlook after earnings miss
items.summary: Delta Air Lines reported adjusted earnings of $1.72 per share, below the roughly $1.81 analyst consensus, and reduced its full-year earnings forecast to $5.10–$5.60 per share from $6.50–$7.50.

crypto_news.query: What are the most significant cryptocurrency and blockchain news from the past 24 hours? Include major price movements, regulatory news, and notable project developments.

items.title: Bitcoin rebounds above $82,500 as crypto liquidations top $1 billion
items.summary: Bitcoin recovered above $82,500 after falling below $81,000 earlier in the week. Improved ETF flows supported sentiment, while 24-hour liquidations reached about $1.02 billion across nearly 165,000 traders.[10]

items.title: Dogecoin gains more than 20% in 24 hours
items.summary: Dogecoin rallied over 20% to approximately $0.47, approaching the psychologically significant $0.50 level. The move occurred alongside continued attention on Dogecoin’s share of merged-mining economics.[3]

items.title: NEAR rises nearly 8% after quantum-resistance upgrade
items.summary: NEAR Protocol announced support for ML-DSA quantum-resistant signatures without requiring users to move their coins. A related proposal to hide account keys is live on testnet, with a mainnet launch expected within weeks.[1]

items.title: China outlines plans for national blockchain network
items.summary: China is reportedly planning a national blockchain network and integrated computing infrastructure as part of a broader digital-economy policy connecting industrial production with digital systems. The policy environment also maintains oversight of stablecoins, tokenized assets and crypto-related businesses.[2]

items.title: BaFin rejects Bitcoin.de operator’s MiCA license application
items.summary: Germany’s BaFin rejected futurum bank AG’s application for a MiCA crypto-asset service-provider license. Bitcoin.de trading remains suspended while the operator evaluates alternatives and seeks a regulated partner.[5]

items.title: BTQ Technologies partners with MoonPay Korea on quantum-resistant stablecoin infrastructure
items.summary: Nasdaq-listed BTQ Technologies announced a strategic partnership with MoonPay Korea to provide post-quantum cryptography for infrastructure supporting a Korean-won-backed stablecoin.[9]

items.title: TruGolf completes acquisition of Polymath Research
items.summary: TruGolf Holdings announced the acquisition of Canadian asset-tokenization company Polymath Research, developer of Polymesh, a Layer 1 blockchain focused on regulated assets and institutional tokenization.[9]

gaming.query: What are the most notable video game and gaming industry news from the past 24 hours? Include game releases, announcements, esports, and industry developments.

items.title: Deadlock surpasses Team Fortress 2’s peak concurrent-player record
items.summary: Valve’s Deadlock reportedly reached more than 262,000 concurrent Steam players after its major City Never Sleeps update, exceeding Team Fortress 2’s cited peak of 253,997.

items.title: Xbox Game Pass adds Valiant Hearts: Coming Home without formal announcement
items.summary: Ubisoft’s Valiant Hearts: Coming Home became available to Game Pass Ultimate subscribers on Xbox Series X|S, PC, and cloud platforms. Another title, Don’t Fret, was also confirmed for the service later this winter.

items.title: GTA 6 leaker reportedly threatens to release playable build
items.summary: A leaker known as Cyberleek reportedly threatened to publish a GTA 6 build containing the full story and ending unless Rockstar met unspecified demands related to PS5 discs.

items.title: Kingdom Hearts IV announced for 2027
items.summary: Square Enix and Disney reportedly announced that Kingdom Hearts IV will launch in the second half of 2027, with a world based on Pixar’s Coco among the newly reported content.

items.title: Take-Two establishes new 2K sports studio
items.summary: Take-Two Interactive reportedly created Small Axe Studio within 2K Games to focus on sports titles.

items.title: Mafia: The Old Country receives Man of Honor expansion
items.summary: Hangar 13 released the Man of Honor add-on for Mafia: The Old Country on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC at a reported price of $10.

items.title: Delta Force exceeds 58 million daily active users in China
items.summary: Tencent’s TiMi Studios reportedly announced that Delta Force surpassed 58 million daily active users in China around the game’s second anniversary.

items.title: Valor Mortis launches after positive early previews
items.summary: The action souls-like Valor Mortis is receiving its global release, with launch coverage highlighting strong early-preview reactions and a newly released launch trailer.
